fields.climate: generally hot and humid; monsoonal-type rainy season (June to November) with southwesterly winds; dry season (December to May) with northeasterly harmattan winds
fields.terrain: generally flat coastal plain, hilly to mountainous interior
fields.hazards: hot, dry, dusty harmattan haze may reduce visibility during dry season
fields.resources: bauxite, iron ore, diamonds, gold, uranium, hydropower, fish, salt
fields.farm: rice, cassava, maize, groundnuts, oil palm fruit, plantains, potatoes, fonio, yams, sweet potatoes
fields.exports: gold, aluminum ore, cocoa beans, crude petroleum, coconuts/brazil nuts/cashews
fields.industries: bauxite, gold, diamonds, iron ore; light manufacturing, agricultural processing
fields.languages: French (official), Pular, Maninka, Susu, other native languages
fields.legal: civil law system based on the French model
fields.military: 18 years of age for voluntary and selective conscripted service; 9-12 months of service
